title: The Accountant
description: Immutable ledger of every Olympian API interaction. Kronos records what was asked, who answered, and what the result was. This file grows with every query — never deleted, only appended.

schema.tick: integer — Kronos's own tick counter, increments per entry
schema.timestamp: ISO 8601 — when the query was processed
schema.olympian: string — which Olympian was queried (zeus, athena, hermes, ...)
schema.operation: string — which query pattern was invoked (judge, brief, translate, ...)
schema.query_params: object — the parameters passed to the Olympian
schema.response_summary: string — compressed summary of the Olympian's response
schema.fidelity: number or null — translation fidelity (Hermes only), null for non-translations
schema.from_domain: string or null — source domain (Hermes only)
schema.to_domain: string or null — target domain (Hermes only)
